name: Ethiopia
famous_for: Rock-hewn monolithic churches of Lalibela, birthplace of Arabica coffee, Simien Mountains, and Lucy fossil.
tourists: Approx. 900,000 visitors; famous for Lalibela rock churches, Danakil Depression lava, and Gondar castles.
must_know: Ethiopia operates on its own ancient calendar with 13 months, lagging roughly 7 years behind the Gregorian calendar.
fun_fact: Ethiopia is the only African nation that successfully defeated European colonizers (Battle of Adwa in 1896).
